title: EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.json - pre-registered evaluation protocol (fair evaluation)
description: Machine-readable mirror of the pre-registration quartet locked by method-registry section 3.6 (metrics lock / baseline parity / baseline re-implementation rule / anti-cherry-picking reporting discipline), consumed by experiment-execution step 6 and enforced by result-to-claim via parity_check / all_seeds_reported / full_grid_reported. The quartet is documented semantically; exact JSON field names are not fixed by the docs yet, so this schema stays minimal (see schemas/README.md known gaps).
